all_words.explanation: A novel is divided into chapters, so the two words belong to the same discussion of how a long prose work is structured.
A giraffe is an African animal and has no connection with fiction, storytelling or literary form.
The protagonist is the central character of a novel, so the word is closely linked to the same literary context.
A novella is a shorter form of prose fiction, so the two words are close in meaning, though a novella is shorter than a novel.
A thermometer measures temperature and is unrelated to literature or narrative writing.
'Plot of a novel' is a common collocation in literary criticism, so the two words are often used together.

explanation: chapter, protagonist, novella and plot are all connected with the structure and content of prose fiction, while giraffe and thermometer have nothing to do with literature.
